Maps load with two downloads at the same time (also when copying from the Core)
Landscape display (320x240) – default on the 2" board, config.txt quer: 0 for portrait

Two own Wi-Fi networks in config.txt (wlan, wlan2) – tried in turn when the Core is off
Without GPS fix: last Core position, otherwise VGPS home position – map shows and maps load right away
Copies all map tiles from the Core (aerial + street map, zoom 13-18) on first contact, then every 30 min
Own Wi-Fi for maps without the Core (config.txt wlan/wlanPass); config.txt is created at first start

First version for the Waveshare 2" touch board (240x320): touch to zoom (left/right), switch aerial/street map (middle), long press for heading/north up
Built-in SD card, more memory for map tiles, own update channel (navi/lcd2)
